facts.text: Default internal timeout is 10000ms. -t accepts a positive integer number of seconds, -T positive integer milliseconds. Invalid values fail argument parsing; use -t before the service name.
Leading + in getopt_long option string stops option parsing at input_method. Following --user and 0 are added unchanged to service args. Exactly one input_method service is selected.
With an explicit single service, setServiceArgs is not called. The fixed command adds no -a, priority or proto service arguments.
Only multiple-service mode adds DUMP OF SERVICE header/footer. The single-service contract must use the IMMS/IMS service-produced headers; requiring a dumpsys wrapper header rejects valid output.

writeDump reads from the service pipe with a steady-clock total deadline. Internal timeout can produce the SERVICE DUMP TIMEOUT marker twice (writeDump and main). main still returns 0 after timeout or read/write errors.
Missing service, pipe creation failure or Binder service->dump error can print stderr while main returns 0. Exit code0 alone is insufficient for a complete dump.
On incomplete dump the worker thread is detached and read end closed. The CLI timeout is not proof that remote system_server/IME dump work was cancelled or all remote work completed.

mustRejectEvenWithExitZero: Failed to create pipe to dump service info for input_method:
Error in poll while dumping service input_method :
Failed to read while dumping service input_method:
Failed to write while dumping service input_method:
hostContract: Preserve bounded combined stdout/stderr (or both originals) and command status, exit code, before/after times and truncation outcome.
Require command completed with zero exit, no host/remote timeout, no byte truncation, no transport failure, no dumpsys error markers, and a complete strictly parsed selected-current-IME body.
Any nonzero exit is unknown/incomplete; do not rely on an assumed timeout-specific numeric exit status to identify failure.
Outer timeout and host budget cover service lookup/start and thread join in addition to the internal -t read budget.
No -w: that flag waits indefinitely for service startup before writeDump timeout begins.
Do not invoke help/probe retries: this was a source review only and the requested command remains single-shot.
outerTimeoutScope: The proposed -s KILL syntax matches the existing raw experiment's already-executed /system/bin/timeout -s KILL 40s wrapper. This review does not pin toybox timeout.c or assert its exact timeout exit code. Require completion/exit0 and reject every failure; neither layer proves cancellation of remote Binder work.
